summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings Ltd (Nasdaq: NCI), a Cayman-incorporated Hong Kong-based apparel firm, furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) containing its AGM proxy statement and proxy card dated September 15, 2026, for a meeting on September 28, 2026. Beyond routine financial-statement approval, shareholders will vote on a special resolution adopting a Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles to eliminate the mandatory annual general meeting requirement and strip Class B shares of conversion, dividend and liquidation rights. Watch the separate Class A/Class B votes and any minority dissent.
